description: No clean concept. Weakly tracks a low-board pattern seen from the mover's side: two opponent stones stacked on my stone in column 6, opponent stones at the bottom of columns 3-4 (and 0) with my stones on top of them, my stone under theirs in column 2, column 1 empty, and the opponent's last move on an edge rather than covering the centre. The colour-swapped pattern does not fire. Most firing near threshold does not fit it.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most about 5 points (col 3 vs col 4), usually under 1 point.
notes: Tried: opponent's last move on an edge (F1 0.11), adding col-6/col-4 top-stone terms (0.13), centre stacking (0.09), positive cell template (0.12, AUROC 0.62), signed template (0.11). Best: signed template, graded output, F1 0.145, AUROC 0.71, sim share 0.05. Synthetic template positions reach 4.96 (dev max 4.14) and activation flips with ply parity (colour-relative). Dev firing is diffuse and many firings contradict the template, so this may be a random direction or a mixture.
